notes.title: Exclusive First Look: 'Please, Watch The Artwork' Live at Tiny Teams
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear lovers of art-touching and/or -watching,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have some news for you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Spin-off[/b][/h3][p]As some of you might know, before continuing my journey on [i][b]'Please, Touch The Artwork 3'[/b][/i] I am first exploring a spin-off game [i][b]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/b][/i], a casual psychological observation game where you'll have to spot differences in paintings, as a night-watch at The Museum of Animated Modern Art (MaMA).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Edward Hopper[/b] [/h3][p]The game uses paintings of American realist painter Edward Hopper
There are no jump scares or monsters, but there are sad clowns and the game might make you a bit paranoid at times.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"]However, I'm 100% sure a lot of you will like it!!![/url][/p][p]And there will be a cozy mode for those who don't like pressure.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Premiere Spotlight[/b][/h3][p]I'm happy to announce the first gameplay will be [b]live-streamed[/b] by the people at The Yogscast during their Tiny Teams event.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]When?[/b][/h3][p]Thursday August 14th at 6AM Pacific Time, 9AM Eastern Time and 2PM British Time (sorry, it's a British event :))[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where:[/b][/h3][p]Steam:  [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][p]Twitch: [/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Youtube:
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p][/p][p]Hope you'll like it![/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Thomas[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [New Game] Night Watch at the Museum, but the Paintings Are Alive
notes.content: [p]Hey everybody![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to introduce my new art-inspired spin-off game: [b][i]Please, Watch The Artwork[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Pitch:[/i][/h3][p][i]Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. Watch, listen and report all changes. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Eerie. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times. And there's a cozy mode![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731779/82140ac941779d8b11f60cdb384e8b8fafae113c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Day Of The Devs[/h3][p]It was announced yesterday during the Summer Game Fest : Day Of The Devs livestream, together with the launch of the Steam-page.[/p][p][/p][p]You can all enjoy my ASMR middle-of-the-night recorded introduction here 😊 :[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/oEm6wAdqfEY?t=3411"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And of course visit the new game's page here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]What about Please, Touch The Artwork 3?[/h3][p][i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] is a spin-off from the [i]'Please, Touch The Artwork'[/i]-series, but [b]NO WORRIES: 'Please, Touch The Artwork 3' is also in the making! [/b]I just wanted to do something different in between projects.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the lovely people at Iam8bit and Double Fine Productions who are doing this as an all-volunteer non-profit to celebrate the magic of videogames![/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice weekend![/p][p]Thomas[/p]

notes.title: New Game Announcement Tonight during Summer Game Fest livestream
notes.content:
Hey touchers-of-art!

Today/tonight I'm revealing my new art-based game [i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] during the Day Of The Devs stream, part of Summer Game Fest.

[i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] is a spin-off from the [i]'Please, Touch The Artwork'[/i]-series, but [b]NO WORRIES: 'Please, Touch The Artwork 3' is also in the making![/b]

I will give a small introduction on why/how I made the game and you'll get to see the world premier of the trailer!

Tune in Friday June 6th (today) at 4pm Pacific Time, 7pm Eastern Time, 1am CEST, right after the official livestream of Summer Game Fest.

Link to the livestream:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Hr6Q2hln_M&ab_channel=thegameawards

Link to the steam-page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/

I'm excited, hope you are too!
Thomas

notes.title: Donation DLC Release
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Touchers-of-art![/h3]

I am overwhelmed with the positive reactions this game has received since its release earlier this year. We've reached more than [b]4000 [/b]reviews and a [b]99%[/b] positive to negative ratio making it one of the [b]top 10 best rated games on Steam in 2024[/b]!
[i][b]!!! THIS IS INSANE !!! [/b][/i]

[h2]First of all: there will be a sequel! [/h2]
[h2]Here's how you can help to make this happen:[/h2]

Many people have written they would have paid for this game (or would still like to pay for it) and so I thought about a way for them to do this without compromising the free nature of the original product (which will always stay 100% free!). 

[h3]DLC's[/h3]

I’ve introduced 3 DLC’s that are [i][b]PURELY COSMETIC[/b][/i]. 
This means they won’t influence the gameplay and only add visual changes to the game.
They are meant to support me in making more games like these (more about that later!)
However, I did want to [b]give you something in return[/b] to there are 3 features you can unlock:

[list]
[*] Your name will be mentioned in the credits of the game as seen on the screenshot.
[*] Your Steam Avatar is a painting somewhere in the game. It's still a hidden object game, so it's up to you to find it!
[*] Your Steam Friends are shown as paintings somewhere in the game. It's still a hidden object game, so it's up to you to find them![/list]

The large donation (Donation L) unlocks all 3 features.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351000/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_L/

The medium donation (Donation M) the first 2 features.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350990/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_M/

The small donation (Donation S) unlocks only the first feature.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350980/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2__Donation_S/

Thank you for your support.
Merry Christmas, and a happy new year!

notes.title: Please, Touch The Artwork 2 adds Linux support
notes.content:
While it was already playable with Proton, the developer of Please, Touch The Artwork 2 has added a Native Linux version.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/07/please-touch-the-artwork-2-adds-linux-support

notes.title: Available on Linux!
notes.content:
Hey lovers-of-touching-art!

I'm happy to announce that "Please, Touch The Artwork 2" is now also available on Linux with a native build. 
It was already SteamDeck compatible but that via Proton (a tool that makes Windows games run on SteamOS/Linux)
It's also still a 1000% free!

Have a nice weekend,
Thomas Waterzooi

notes.title: Some Next Fest Art Touching | AMA | 100% Free Game
notes.content:
Dear artventurers!

Join us as solo-dev Thomas Waterzooi talks about the making of Please, Touch The Artwork 2, a hidden object adventure set in the surreal world of Belgian painter James Ensor.
Why does he make games about art and what’s the roadmap ahead for future games?
All while playing the soon to be released game (19th of February!) 

! By the way !
The game will be 100% free in honour of the 75th Anniversary of Ensor’s death, so there is no reason not to wishlist ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600140/Please_Touch_The_Artwork_2/

Check out the first instalment in the series here, which is a cozy puzzle game inspired by art-movement The Style. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097100/Please_Touch_The_Artwork/

Get in touch via the Discord:

Cheers!
Thomas Waterzooi
